question: cuántos productos lleva de media una cesta
sql: SELECT AVG(ol.quantity) AS ticket_medio_productos FROM fact_order_line ol JOIN v_payment_intent vi ON ol.payment_intent_id = vi.payment_intent_id WHERE vi.eventually_approved = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_intent_id = vi.payment_intent_id AND pa.is_test = true) GROUP BY 1
